title: The Master and the Disciple
content_summary: Cover slide with title and subtitle over a decorative cosmological diagram.
text_blocks: The Cosmological Blueprint and the Path of Return

title: The Scale of Incomparability
content_summary: Nested rings illustrating the incommensurable scale between Earth, Air, Heaven, and Allah.
text_blocks: The Heaven in relation to the full extent of Air.
Like a tiny egg resting in an immense plain.
Ratio fails. The sign announces the failure of signs. "And Allah's is the loftiest similitude." (16:60).
Like a single seal-ring discarded in a great plain.
Atmosphere in relation to the Heavens.
Like a seal-ring in a vast desert.

Lesser symbols and peer-to-peer comparisons slot the Creator into a series with His creatures, demoting Him to a rung. The highest permitted symbol (Air) announces incommensurability through sheer scale.

title: The Densification Ladder
content_summary: Five-level descending ladder from the Originator through Will, Command, and Speech, densifying into the seven heavens and seven earths.
text_blocks: No model, no precedent, no peer.
A perpetual act, the will still willing.
Denser; requires direction and an addressee.

title: The Numerical Signatures of the Cosmos
content_summary: Three-row table mapping primordial phrases to letter counts and the cosmic structures they mirror.
text_blocks: The Numerical Signatures of the Cosmos
Mirrored above in 7 heavens, 7 rulers. Mirrored below in 7 seas, 7 days.
Mirrored above in 12 zodiac mansions. Mirrored below in 12 terrestrial regions, 12 hours of day, 12 hours of night.
Recited daily, decoded rarely. Mirrors irada alone (Allah) + amr-qawl pair (al-rahman + al-rahim). Legible only to those holding the covenant key.

title: The Architecture of the Heavenly Mirror
content_summary: Four-tier mapping of the human spiritual hierarchy onto celestial bodies.
text_blocks: The Architecture of the Heavenly Mirror
"Bright beyond bearing, veiled by its own brightness."
(Twelve to an Imam, one per region).
"Borrowed light, never out of phase with its source."
(Thirty per Bab, mirroring days under months).

title: Mutual Subsistence: The Body and Spirit of Religion
content_summary: Two-column comparison of Zahir (outer) and Batin (inner) dimensions of religion across identity, role, and standing alone.
text_blocks: Mutual Subsistence: The Body and Spirit of Religion
The revealed paths, the outward ordinances of the Law.
The true religion of Allah, the esoteric meanings.
The body, the covering, the sign pointing to the inner.
A corpse. A body without a spirit. Case 2 Seeker: keeps prayer/fast, lacks the animating spirit (Kafir in the root sense: one who hides the seed).
A wraith. A spirit without a body. Case 1 Seeker: knows the meanings, drops prayer/fast. Fruit peeled before ripening; rots.
Mutual subsistence is the doctrine. Neither alone is a living religion.

title: The Anatomy of Knowledge
content_summary: Two grouped tables: three dimensions of reality (Zahir/Batin/Batin al-Batin) and three registers of creatures (beasts, humans, angels).
text_blocks: Outer aspect only. Registers without understanding. Recites but never asks. Intellect turned toward the ground.
Inner aspect of the physical. The alim rabbani. True descendants of Adam. Intellect turned toward what the visible means.
Inner of the inner. Purely spiritual knowledge in a physical body. The prophet, the vicegerent. Intellect turned back toward its origin.

title: Emptying the Cup (Kasrah)
content_summary: Three-stage flow showing the traditional scholar's solid vessel shattered by demolition into a new receptacle.
text_blocks: Polished by years of being 'right', leaving nowhere for a new thing to land.
The ground must be forcefully broken. Salih's initial dialogue is a calculated act of demolition.
Only once the cup is empty can a new seed be planted by the Mukasir (The Demolisher).
Emptying the cup is a recognized necessity of spiritual pedagogy.

title: The Ledger of the Covenant
content_summary: Two side-by-side ledger panels contrasting the thief's flawed reward arithmetic with the Imam's verdict on the covenant-less act.
text_blocks: The Arithmetic of the Covenant-less Act (The Stolen Apples)
Calculation: +50 rewards (giving the apples to charity), -5 sins (for the theft).
Calculation: -5 sins (for the initial theft), -5 sins (for propagating forbidden goods into another's hand).
A sacred act is blessed under the pact of Allah. A stolen act (fornication vs. marriage; forbidden meat vs. ritual slaughter) carries no allegiance. The covenant-less act cannot be sanctified.

title: The Mechanics of the Tawaf
content_summary: Orbital diagram of pilgrims/planets circling a central sun-Imam-Ka'ba, with centrifugal and centripetal threats labeled.
text_blocks: Centrifugal Threat: Leaving the orbit means losing the center and freezing in the dark.
Centripetal Threat: Falling straight toward the center means consumption.
The Seven Circuits (stages of life given to the embryonic soul)
The orbit is the precise shape in which love keeps the pilgrim alive.

title: The Conspiracy Formula
content_summary: Four-epoch flow of recurring conspiracies plus a triangle naming the three colluding actors and their unified output.
text_blocks: Tend the calf, submit to judges.
Venerate priests, worship prophet as God.
Unified Output: "There is no messenger after ours."
Legitimation + Force + Temptation makes falsehood attractive and opposition costly.

title: The Forty-Year Syllogism
content_summary: Two-horn dilemma diagram showing both branches of the son's challenge to his father terminate in dead ends.
text_blocks: The son addresses the father regarding his newfound knowledge.
The father was a scholar of this truth but intentionally withheld my share.
The father was ignorant of this truth, making him more in need of the stranger than I am.
Conclusion: You have no standing to condemn me.
There is no third position. The disjunctive dilemma closes every escape route, mathematically securing the disciple's release.

title: Complicity by Rank
content_summary: Scale-balance illustration weighing the executioner against the legitimizing scholar, with the scholar judged heavier.
text_blocks: Place in the chain: Upstream. Supplies the intellectual legitimation.
Visible offense: Blackens a flag or fills an inkwell.
Verdict: Worse than the murderer himself. Without the scholar's fatwas and opinions, the oppressor could not maintain dominion.
Place in the chain: At the very end of the action.
Visible offense: Lifting the physical hand.
The Verdict of the Scales: The Weight of Intellectual Legitimation Far Exceeds the Physical Act of Violence. True Power Resides in the Authority to Justify.

title: The Unbroken Chain of Witnesses
content_summary: Two horizontal prophet-chains (Abraham to Moses, Moses to Jesus) framing a central panel on the cause of concealment.
text_blocks: Upholds the community of Abraham throughout. Torah is sent down.
He dislikes the enemies' actions, but abandons the friends. This is the operative cause of concealment. Once the community helps the friends of Allah, they reveal themselves.
Upholds the judgment of the Torah. Gospel is sent down.

title: The Debt of Transmission
content_summary: Flow from the Heavenly Host through generations to the Persian Scholar arriving at an empty slot representing the listener's debt.
text_blocks: The unfilled slot is the debt itself. Every node before it received, and then gave. You are the listener now hearing this.
"The most excellent of deeds is giving life to the dead."
